verdict.rationale: Yapily has a structured API reference (endpoint docs like get-accounts, create-bulk-payment-authorisation, etc.) and an OpenAPI spec used for client-library generation, plus a sandbox for testing, but there is no evidence of an interactive, in-browser 'try it now' console or embedded runnable code examples—an openapi.json probe even returned 404 at expected locations. missing for 10: explicit interactive try-it/run console in docs, confirmed live OpenAPI spec endpoint, runnable code snippets embedded in reference pages.
